input.summary: Tungabhadra Actives LLP (V02). Sent quotation plus Niacinamide COA dated 2026-03-10 (now over 6 months old). Quote footnote not yet clarified. Anand stated propanediol drum is 215 kg net, so the drum-to-kg point is answered. Offered an extra 3% if we disclose competing quotes and our next-year forecast. Declined with the required sentence; no volume or award implied. Open: RM-003 fresh COA (issue tries 3 left). Gaps to ask now: Q5 (COA per line, knockout), Q9 (SDS and leave-on suitability, knockout), Q6, Q8. Peptide cold-zone limits (2 free pallet positions, 2-8 C) were stated in our outbound email.

input.subject: RE: KPC-2026-014 - Quotation received, documents required
input.body:
Dear Mr. Anand,

Thank you for your quotation and the Niacinamide COA for RFx KPC-2026-014. We have noted your footnote and will review it with the quotation.

Regarding your request for information on other quoters and our forecast: This is sensitive company information, so we will not be sharing it. This does not change how we evaluate your quotation.

Regarding your propanediol drum size (215 kg net), thank you for confirming.

To continue the evaluation, please provide the following:

1. The COA for the Niacinamide (RM-003). The COA dated 2026-03-10 is more than 6 months old. Please send a COA from a recent batch, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.
2. For each of the 10 lines quoted, a COA from a recent batch showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.
3. The Safety Data Sheet for each material, and written confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
4. Your rejection rate over the last 12 months, and the certifications you hold with their expiry dates.
5. Whether you are the manufacturer or a trader. If you are a trader, name the manufacturer and site, state any second source, and confirm whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Please reply by return. Missing items may prevent us from considering your quotation.

Regards,
Procurement Manager, Coimbatore plant
Kesavi Personal Care
